records.name: Intelligence Briefing
records.description: Follow your topics across fifty publishers, ten each from the far left, left, centre, right and far right, side by side. Hard news only by default.

records.name: Global Headline Tracker
records.description: Any country's last 24 hours of news on a map, with daily, weekly, monthly and yearly archives of its top stories in the same view.

records.name: Geopolitical Volatility
records.description: A daily 0–100 index of conflict, political escalation, unrest, economic disruption and cross-border spread for every country, from GDELT. Compare up to four countries.

records.name: Realtime Battlefield
records.description: Every armed conflict this year, grouped into wars, with plain-English briefings, a monthly archive and related coverage. UCDP data, refreshed monthly.

records.name: National Analysis
records.description: Every country's PESTLE pressures, plus how it is governed, how often its leaders change and how much conflict it has seen. 41 indicators; compare up to four countries.

records.name: Political Atlas
records.description: Who holds power across 78 countries now: executives, legislatures, courts, elections, policies and challenges. Refreshed monthly.

records.name: Realtime Calendar
records.description: Upcoming elections, referendums and summits, plus the last six months of political events: new leaders, inaugurations and resignations, coups, wars and ceasefires, protests and strikes, parliamentary votes, court rulings, sanctions and party contests. Month or year view, any country or just the ones you highlight.

records.name: Encyclopaedia
records.description: Every person, place, war, party, idea, scientist and discovery in PRP. Filter with Boolean tag queries (e.g. Realist + American + "Political science") and jump to everywhere each one appears across the suite.

records.name: Political Retrospective
records.description: Move a slider from 1926 to today: historical borders, who was in charge of each country, and the key political events of every year, with Wikipedia links.

records.name: Retrospective Battlefield
records.description: Move a slider from 1926 to 2025 to see every war and armed conflict on a historical map, with sides, intensity and Wikipedia links.

records.name: War Focus
records.description: The major wars of the last hundred years month by month: fronts and territory on a map with a slider, battles, casualties and key facts, in the style of Ollie Bye's history-by-day videos.

records.name: Kardashev Tracker
records.description: Which empires and countries controlled what share of humanity's energy capture from 2000 BC to today, after Ian Morris, with humanity's Kardashev rating century by century.

records.name: Historical Calendar
records.description: Political history from 1980 to today in one calendar: elections and referendums, new leaders and resignations, coups, wars and ceasefires, summits, protests, court rulings and more, each with a plain-English account.

records.name: Learning · Politics
records.description: The political spectrum through its leaders and thinkers: far left, left, centre, right (Mearsheimer and the Realists) and far right, with quizzes.

records.name: OSINT Dashboard
records.description: An investigator's workbench for open sources: search across engines and archives, domains, company and sanctions records, event monitoring and image checks, with a case notebook that grades every source. Plus a Software Cookbook and a Kit Guide.

records.name: SIGINT Dashboard
records.description: Receive-only signals monitoring: aircraft (ADS-B), ships (AIS), satellites, LoRa mesh, GNSS interference and space weather from public feeds or your own receivers, plus a Software Cookbook and a Hardware Guide for hobbyists.

records.name: GEOINT & IMINT Dashboard
records.description: Geospatial and imagery intelligence: daily satellite imagery and night lights with before/after comparison, active fires, terrain, OpenStreetMap features, measuring and sun/shadow tools for geolocation and chronolocation. Plus a Software Cookbook and a Hardware Guide.

records.name: Intel Training
records.description: Courses in intelligence tradecraft, each with quizzes and capstone exercises: OSINT (the intelligence cycle, sources, search, verification, records, analysis and the law), SIGINT (radio fundamentals and lawful, receive-only monitoring of aircraft, ships, satellites and the spectrum) and GEOINT & IMINT (satellite imagery, geolocation, chronolocation and measurement), and how to use PRP’s dashboards for each.

records.name: Market Briefing
records.description: Markets now: indices, rates, FX, commodities and crypto, movers, news, ticker pages and the Hype Tracker of tickers suddenly talked about or traded far more than usual.

records.name: Economics Briefing
records.description: Economics news and scholarly articles from 50 feeds: NBER and CEPR working papers, the top journals, the BIS, ECB, Fed and Bank of England, VoxEU, Brookings and other think tanks, and the FT, Economist and Bloomberg, with a toggle by field (macro, monetary policy, trade, labour, development, finance, public finance, energy).

records.name: Auto Trader
records.description: What members of Congress (including Nancy Pelosi) and famous investors such as Buffett, Burry and Ackman are buying and selling, from STOCK Act and SEC 13F filings, and an agent that mirrors any of them or trades in their style.

records.name: Algo Trader
records.description: Create trading agents that follow a ruleset: Double Agent (stocks that double within hours), Hype Rider (the Hype Tracker), and more. Each simulates first, has its own pot and passes the shared risk limits. Private.

records.name: Tally Stick
records.description: Trading 212, Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, Coinbase and Kraken in one ledger: balances, positions, orders, rules, risk limits, the kill switch and an MCP connection for AI agents. Private.

records.name: Learning · Finance & Economics
records.description: Two courses: Finance, a university-style introduction with worked examples and quizzes, and Economics, taught through Smith, Marx, Keynes, Mises, Friedman and Werner.

records.name: Scientific Briefing
records.description: New papers and news from the major journals and science desks (Nature, Science, Cell, PNAS, PRL and more), with a toggle for physics, chemistry, biology, earth & environment, and astronomy & space.

records.name: Timeline of Progress
records.description: Move a slider through history to see key scientific breakthroughs appear where they happened, tagged by discipline, discoverer and institution, and linked to the Encyclopaedia.

records.name: Digital Briefing
records.description: New papers and news on AI, computing, cybersecurity, chips, networks, quantum computing, data and digital policy, from the major journals, preprint servers, labs and technology desks, with a toggle by field.

records.name: Data Analytics
records.description: Explore and chart PRP’s own data: pick any dataset from the catalogue, filter, group and aggregate it, draw charts in PRP’s style, export them, and hand the analysis to an AI assistant.

records.name: Integration Hub
records.description: Connect AI assistants and plugins to PRP: a catalogue of every dataset, a read-only MCP server, a JSON API, feeds and calendars, and setup guides for Claude and other tools.

records.name: Political Events
records.description: Documentaries on political turning points, starting with the Russian Revolutions of 1917, the Partition of India and the Revolutions of 1989.

records.name: Political Figures
records.description: Lives in power, told with maps, timelines, portraits and their own words: Winston Churchill, Franklin D. Roosevelt and Deng Xiaoping to begin with.

records.name: Political Parties
records.description: How parties rise, rule and adapt, starting with the Chinese Communist Party, Mexico's Institutional Revolutionary Party and Japan's Liberal Democratic Party.

records.name: Wars
records.description: Wars from their causes to their aftermath, starting with the Second World War in Europe, the Korean War and the Vietnam War, with maps that follow War Focus month by month.

records.name: Geopolitical Events
records.description: Moments that reshaped the world order, starting with the Cuban Missile Crisis, the end of the Soviet Union and the end of empire in Africa.

records.name: Great Thinkers
records.description: Three-part courses with a short quiz on the great minds PRP draws on, starting with Niccolò Machiavelli, Adam Smith and Karl Marx.
